The best time to visit Vanuatu is during the **dry season from May to October**.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)

### The Dry Season (May – October)

- **Weather:** Pleasant temperatures range from 21°C to 27°C with lower humidity and minimal rainfall.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)
- **Best For:** Hiking volcano trails, scuba diving, island hopping, and outdoor sightseeing.[[1]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-au/explore/destination/the-best-time-to-visit-vanuatu-what-to-expect-each-season-acc/1010769)[[2]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)
- **Key Events:** Traditional land diving on Pentecost Island takes place from April to June, and cultural festivals like *Fest'Napuan* happen in October.[[1]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/nz/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)[[2]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)
- **Crowds:** This is the most popular time to travel, though Vanuatu rarely feels overcrowded. Booking accommodation and flights early is recommended.[[1]](https://www.virginaustralia.com/au/en/destinations/vanuatu/best-times-to-visit-vanuatu/)[[2]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-vanuatu)[[3]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)

### The Wet Season (November – April)

- **Weather:** Hot, very humid, and rainy, with temperatures averaging around 28°C. This period also carries a risk of tropical storms and cyclones (especially from January to February).[[1]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-vanuatu)[[2]](https://www.vanuatu.travel/en/things-to-know/travel-tips/weather)[[3]](https://www.intrepidtravel.com/nz/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit-vanuatu)
- **Best For:** Budget-conscious travelers looking for lower prices, lush rainforests, and dramatic waterfalls.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[2]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-vanuatu)
- **Crowds & Deals:** Far fewer tourists visit during these months, meaning better resort and flight deals, though underwater visibility for diving can sometimes drop due to runoff.[[1]](https://www.travelonline.com/vanuatu/best-time-to-visit)[[2]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/guide-to-vanuatu)
